name: onecup-site
description: OneCup corporate site — WordPress child theme for Hello Elementor

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/onecup && cp -R src/theme/onecup/. dist/onecup && cp -R src/config dist/onecup/config && cd dist && zip -qr onecup.zip onecup
scripts.preview: npm run build:demo && npx --yes serve dist/demo
